# PosBuzz - Cloud Point of Sale & Multi-Branch Retail Platform

> PosBuzz is a modern cloud-native, offline-first Point of Sale (POS) and Multi-Branch Inventory Platform engineered for retail boutiques, apparel stores, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, and multi-store chains.

## Key Active Capabilities & Architecture
- **Offline-First Point of Sale**: Ring up transactions, scan barcodes, take cash/card/MFS payments, and print thermal receipts without active internet. Auto-syncs when online.
- **Multi-Branch Inventory & Stock Transfers**: Centralized product catalogs, branch-specific pricing, and dispatch-approved inter-store stock transfers.
- **Batch Expiry (FEFO) & Serial Number Tracking**: Batch lots with expiry alerts and serialized warranty lookups.
- **Multi-Tender Payments**: Cash, Cards, Bank Transfers, and MFS (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay).
- **Quotations to Sales**: Pro-forma quotation generator with 1-click invoice conversion.
- **Customer Rewards & Loyalty Engine**: Point accrual per dollar spent, customer ledger, and tiered promotional campaigns.
- **Blind End-of-Day (EOD) Cash Reconciliation**: Tamper-proof shift closing with automated discrepancy alerts.
- **Direct Thermal Hardware Bridge**: Plug-and-play driverless ESC/POS printing over USB, LAN/Ethernet, Bluetooth, and Serial COM.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Starter ($24/mo billed annually / $29 monthly)**: 1 store, 2 POS registers, 5,000 SKUs, offline engine, thermal receipt printing.
- **Professional ($64/mo billed annually / $79 monthly)**: Up to 5 stores, unlimited products, multi-branch transfers, batch/serial tracking, loyalty rewards, blind EOD audit.
- **Enterprise ($169/mo billed annually / $199 monthly)**: Unlimited outlets, dedicated private cloud or on-premise VM option, custom webhooks, 99.99% SLA.
